[h2]Shop Titans - Lowk Cozy Merchant Sim[/h2]
If you've ever wanted to play as an shopkeeper in a fantasy world, this is it. 
[b]Why it’s worth playing:[/b]
* [b]Chill Gameplay:[/b] Super laid-back and low stress. Most of your time is spent crafting gear or sending heroes off on quests.
* [b]Low Spec Friendly:[/b] Runs smoothly even on a potato PC.
* [b]Fits Busy Schedules:[/b] Perfect for alt-tabbing while working or playing in short bursts.

It can be a really fun idle game that you can leave running in the background of your pc and then check on from time to time, or you can get it on mobile and check it every few hours. I would say for most things I like the UI setup better on pc than on mobile. The only thing I like about mobile really is when you open up your crafting page you get a big list you can scroll down, on pc its a side scrolling list. You don't need to pay for the membership to have a lot of fun in the game but if you want to get further in events and be able to reset questing faster its definitely a plus to have it.

Been playin for years.  Fun take on being the NPC instead of the hero. You can play without buying all the extras, but some of them are really worth it.  If you want to try it, be free to play for a while.  Consider how much time you get out of the game before buying stuff.  Extra crafting trees are where the best value is at.  Dollars per hour in what I've spent on this over the years has to be in the pennies.

reviews.text:
I love the game but there are a few things that keep me from giving it a solid five star.  Like all pay to play games it can be frustrating with long wait times to finish quests and items unless you spend a LOT of money.  Also, the fact that in order to get special characters you have to spend up to $30 per character is a bit much.  I have PC/Console games that cost that much for the whole entire game.  There is an option to pay $9.99 per month which I would consider using except that the special characters are not part of the monthly fee.  You still have to spend extra to get them and their special items.  

With that said, I would totally give it a solid five star for their customer service.  Customer services is EXCELLENT.  I had a few issues with game and when I contacted them, they were super quick to answer and very efficient.  

Overall, I enjoy playing the game!

reviews.text:

I would buy the extra characters if it were $5-$10 but I just think a lot more people would invest in the add-ones if it weren’t so overpriced. I would love if you could buy/sell keys in the market or purchase them with diamonds because keys rarely drop in missions or reroll in the fortune zone.

Great work but please consider what I’ve written as I think it’ll make the game a lot more enjoyable!

reviews.title: Awesome game with awesome devs!
reviews.text: I don’t write reviews often, but this game deserves one! Great gameplay, awesome progression, and its super easy to pick up. It starts out very easy to understand, but gets very in depth the more you play and do your research. I’m a minmaxer when it comes to games, and my wife is very casual, and this game suits both of our play styles. She’s always asking me questions on how to optimize her progress, but you never actually need to in order to have fun. I’ve also got tot give a shout-out to the devs. I play a lot of games and there are very few games that are as generous and communicative as Kabam! If there’s a bug, they are always quick to address it, and will reward you in-game as an apology for the inconvenience. Most devs will ignore a problem until it becomes too big, but not these guys. Awesome work!

reviews.title: Supremely fun but prices are too high
reviews.text:
I love this game, I truly do. I run a top 2K guild and am happy with the people I have met here. I have been playing since late July and am enjoying every minute, checking in multiple times a day.

But here’s the thing...

You ask for people to pay a LOT of money for your packs and workers. $20 or $30 dollars for a worker with a handful of blueprints? $15 for a content pack that only contains 6 items? That’s absolutely insane. You’d make a lot more money cutting your prices in half, and I am sure you would still make a profit. Please consider it because it’s a constant refrain for those of us who play—“It’s not worth it for the price. I could buy an entire video game for that instead of a couple of add-on packs.”

reviews.title: Addicting
reviews.text: The game is pretty addicting and it isn’t really complicated at all, it’s time consuming but there’s also ways for it to be fast very fast faced without having to spend real money which is what I love about these games. It’s free and not forcing you to pay, just grind a little to get gems and join an active guild. There’s even a in-game help chat which is unlike others cause usually it takes forever to get an answer and sometimes it isn’t even good help, I had a small problem with the new update as I couldn’t see energy bar not realizing all I had to do what a simple restart the app. I can fully enjoy it and they just updated it adding a new way of getting something to progress faster/better!

reviews.title: Great game with great support
reviews.text:
This is a fun little game which has free to play as well as pay to play options. The combination between solo play and being part of a guild community is really balanced. It has features for every player type. Recently there have been a lot of bugs but there is always an update and I can tell the developers are always working to correct any issues. 

My sister and I played this game together and when she recently passed I contacted support and asked if there was anyway to preserve her account. They sent me a thoughtful condolence letter along with pictures of her and her shop so I could remember the time we spent in the game together.

reviews.title: Great game but major issues
reviews.text: Amazing game with lots of fun parts but two things greatly detract from your experience when playing. The first is that it starts to take more and more time for things to be finished the further you get in the game such as upgrading furniture or making items from blueprints at higher tiers. The second is the real issue which is that there is a HUGE paywall in this game for almost every available content and to make things worse they constantly remind you about it too. As a kind of last note, I have heard quite a bit about crashing issues but I personally haven’t encountered that much so I won’t discuss that problem further. Overall it’s fun to just try out for a bit but not really the kind of game I would like long term.

reviews.title: Decent game, but overall wants money
reviews.text: This game keeps my jittery hands busy and I like the art of it and that it’s not too fast paced. That being said, this game is also set so that you can’t get anything interesting unless you pay money. It would be nice if they gave you interesting furniture and other rewards during the events that don’t make you pay money, but mostly you get blueprints and power up seeds (or whatever they are) that way. They also rarely drop anything good when you send your heroes on missions/adventures. Be prepared to miss out on all the nice looking event furniture and items if you can’t afford to pay for them. They make sure to dangle it in front of you too. I would love to give this game 5 stars but my frustration with what I mentioned gives me pause.

reviews.title: Love the game buuuut
reviews.text:
I’ve played many games and I’ve always ended up uninstalling it due to losing interest or being pushed too much to spend money to level up. 
I absolutely love this game! It’s fun. 
The only thing I’d change about this game is the prices. The subscription isn’t much but to get packages is a little ridiculous. 
Mostly kids play this game and the game makes it almost impossible to repair your equipment. 
I’ve only been playing for a week and I’ve already spent a ton on gems repairing my equipment. Could you think about changing out having to have a subscription to repair with gold?? Because 37 gems to fix one item is becoming a hassle.

reviews.title: The game is a 5 star
reviews.text: I noticed the most recent review was a one star and the reason was bc they believed there was a paywall but in reality there isn’t. I’ve been playing for a solid month and a half lvl 36 but all the in game purchases you could get are not needed yes you do get special crafting recipes but other than that things like the content pass you can acquire by having enough gems. The way you level up is by selling items and the more you progress the more their worth and the easier it is to level up. If you really want to get the most out of this game join a guild that’s mostly active in chat and it’ll be a good time waster.

reviews.title: Amazing Game!
reviews.text: I have played this game for over a year and it’s my go to! The graphics are amazing, the characters interesting and the amount of things to do is engaging. I love all of the different events and the cooperation it take from guild members to earn rewards. The game does have a long progression between levels, but with patience you can do it without spending money. There are no ads, so the in game purchases are expensive, but generous. I have bought some on occasion. The Dev’s care about their players, they listen to our requests and do their best to accommodate. Keep up the good work! Overall, this is a great game! Get it and you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect
reviews.text:
This game is very addicting and there’s a good formula here for a progress/time ratio. My biggest complaint is that this game REQUIRES that you be present and playing it to make any progress. And for a mobile game, that can be both a blessing and a curse.

Secondly, this game gives you chests every once in a while and the only way to get them is to literally gamble for it. The process has so many steps that it’s almost not worth it. Get a ticket, use the ticket to gamble, get a few tickets from gambling. Wash, rinse, repeat 100 times and FINALLY you can buy a single key to open a chest. The prospect of earning the keys takes so much effort that it doesn’t even feel like a reward. And there’s not way to buy your way out.

Other than that this is a solid game.

reviews.title: Amazing and addictive until update
reviews.text:
I’ve had this game for more then 4 months and up until last week still actively played it. The latest update completely destroyed the market in the game, making you unable to sell or buy anything enchanted. With the level restrictions also not allowing you to buy things unless you’re a certain level (even if you can make that stuff yourself) the market, simultaneously stopped all the items I sold in the market, and what I could buy.   

I don’t understand the thought process behind this as many people only buy things from the market that they can’t make. And even more so, the reason for buying the runestone package (20-30$ to make elements) has now been rendered useless since you can’t sell them anymore. 
Had this happened a month ago, I would’ve never spent money on this app. Fun game but poor choices.

reviews.title: What happened?!?!?
reviews.text:
This new version update did bring some more customization options which is great, but now customers come to your shop for gear/items you don’t have and have never even made. Why would I go to a hardware store to buy a bathrobe? It doesn’t make sense. I’m just turning customers away left and right because they’re asking for things I don’t even have blueprints for. Yes, I could buy the missing item from the market for the customer and then up-sale the item, but the problem is that everything in the market is now insanely expensive! A rank 1 pair of boots that I normally sell for 100 gold now costs 1000 gold to buy in the market. Reselling for a profit is nearly impossible this way when up-selling the item typically only nets you double the item’s base amount (so 200 gold in this case).

Please put the customer supply/demand back as it was.

reviews.title: Beautifully designed, but crashes.
reviews.text: As the title says it is a overall good game. Seen what happens if I get far enough ahead, but recently it tends to crash suddenly after awhile. Otherwise, nice game for casual gamers, but it needs a(n) auto-build function. Basically building a certain amount of something automatically before stopping. For example, I want to have all craftables built that does not need to rely on quests, but you can keep the function that you have to actively keep an eye on it so that it to keep it going. The list of craftable items keep on growing, which makes it hard if you want to have at least one of each on display. I have to continuously/constantly jump between the crafting window and fulfilling customers needs.

reviews.title: Super addicting game
reviews.text:
I’ve had a ton of fun so far with this game. Joining a friendly guild who all cooperate to upgrade the town is very helpful. I also like the fact there’s no real need to spend real money on this game unless you want to progress faster or unlock different workers from the town who can craft different things. That being said the cost for the workers is pretty outrageous, the cost for the engineer is $30, but again so far there’s no need to unlock the special workers.

One suggestion would be to make it so you can assign certain items to a specific table/mannequin slot so there’s only one on display and it will always restock to that slot if there’s another of that item in your inventory.

reviews.title: Stand alone.
reviews.text:
I played this on and off but was never dissatisfied with any aspect. Little over a year and a half ago I found the perfect guild for me and have played every day since. 

NO ADS!! That’s huge. Also if you wanted to spend real money, sure it helps but this is not a pay to win game. I personally have the subscription because I find it worth it. It’s a complete game. The devs are quick to fix bugs if/when they arise. Best shop management game I have played. 

If I had to not sound like a homer, find one thing to critique…it would be how grindy xp is once past 72. I’m reaching for that one. Definitely my most played mobile game.

reviews.text: Having fun as a casual player but by level 25 this games thrown  special offers valued  well over $200 at me not including the monthly subscription. many paths are  completely blocked behind the paywall . I came here to play a game where I play  around and farm out  my progress not where the devs are farming the contents of my wallet. reviews.text:

It’s worth downloading and I highly recommended it. I even had 4 of my friends hooked… sadly my first friend stopped playing 5 month in… I’m was the last one and honestly the game feel the same even without them…

reviews.title: Fantastic pacing!
reviews.text:
Okay, I wanna start by saying I deleted this app pretty soon after downloading it yet I still think it’s fantastically fun, well-paced, fully engaging—BUT: TOO ADDICTIVE.

I have rarely played a free-to-play game that was so well balanced and paced. I absolutely tip my hat to the developers. There is a ton to do and it requires almost your full attention. There is no down time. Just a nice steady build of dopamine with the frequent feelings of accomplishment.

Everything I thought I was hitting a stopping point there was something else to do and focus on. The pace of building is really smooth, where it’s never too easy or hard. Precisely engineered to keep you hooked.

While I commend the dev team for a fantastic play experience, I feel the grasp of the Skinner-box and can see all they ways it pushes my buttons. I put a SOLID 18-hours in and that’s enough.

Have fun! Just delete the game

reviews.title: A fun shopkeeper game
reviews.text: If you are looking for a cute little game where you get to run your own store for heroes then this is the app for you! Its quaint. Try not to get disturbed in the beginning as the NPCs pop up alot but over time they leave you to your own devices once they get the basics on how to play out of the way. You can even guild up with other shop owners and invest in a town together. The better the town the better gear and resources you receive to make clothing and sell it to adventurous heroes! It fun! I wish they had a more detailed and hands on version for PC as a full game instead of a timer based app. I would pay alot of money for it since this is alot like Fable graphics wise.

reviews.text:
My game “reset” after iPhone update. I had not logged into Game Center to save it so when I opened game it was gone. Emailed support. 
Next day I get a reply with instructions on what to do which I followed immediately sending screenshots back. They didn’t email me again til next day saying my game was not connected to Game Center and they couldn’t help me. They told me to hit the connect button twice to disconnect then connect. 
Well, my button doesn’t do that. And it SAYS connected as well as Game Center even welcomes me when I’m log on. Was lvl 27 and guild leader. Don’t play this game or spend money unless you log in via Facebook/Game Center as you may lose it and despite what they claim they really won’t help you.

reviews.title: Fun, but I hit a wall
reviews.text:
The game is just a fun little time waster, which I really enjoy! But once you reach lvl 50, you just hit a wall. Everything is so expensive, the members of the guild keep leaving which takes all the money they’ve invest in the town shops, so the shops never get high enough to advance my crafting. I can’t expand my shop because I’m trying to invest all my money in the town shops, millions at a time which don’t even make a dent in leveling them up, so it feels pointless.
I still pop on at least once a day, more if time allows, I just feel stuck in an endless loop at this point. So, good game not great because it caters too much to the newbies and not enough to us loyal ones who have played for a long time.

reviews.title: Like any other pay to win
reviews.text: As far as shop games go, it’s fun. But the premium packs pop up every few weeks. On top of a subscription. Free to play May hold you awhile, but it will burn you out. The game works by linking your time to your money - and wasting your time until you’re willing to open your wallet. Even then, it gets old. And if your guild mates get sick of it, the game punishes the entire guild for it. People play out of obligation to their guilds until they can’t stand it. Then you watch all the friends you made scatter to other guilds here and there - each with only an open spot or two. The game isn’t properly setup to be fun long term. It’s not designed for it. It’s designed to bait you, hook you, and milk whatever it can from you. Like any other freemium game on the App Store.

reviews.title: Crashing a lot :(
reviews.text: I really like this game! I just downloaded it after seeing it pop up as an ad in other games so many times. It’s really interesting and I would like to spend more time playing it, but it’s making me so frustrated with how often it crashes. I even updated my phone to the most recent update and tried to restart it hoping that might help but it didn’t. I can only play the game for about 3-4 minutes before it kicks me out and I have to reload back in. Also everything I do up to the crash resets, like finishing up crafting or sending out a quest so I have to do it again and hope the crash holds off. Hopefully something can be done about it soon because I do enjoy the game, I just hate getting thrown out after a couple minutes.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text:
It’s very much like Shop Heroes, but I actually like this one better so far! I like that there’s no limit to how many workers we can have at one time, so when you hire them they’re always available. 
I just wish that there was an auto sell option for when I’m not playing, like maybe items would sell every 10 minutes or something? Also I’d like to see my item recipes without going into the crafting menu, because at times I start making something that takes a while but then I want to check a different recipe’s components. Would also be helpful if the crafting menu showed how long each item takes to make.

reviews.text:

Love the game, I also enjoy the update quite a bit. I like the chance to get the customer to buy something instead of leaving along with the new customization options. My only complain would be the removal of the mute button. reviews.title: This game is my go to game.
reviews.text: No ads! Period. No need to buy gems or anything else. Bide your time and you can move up. It’s more fun in a guild as some of the events work out better as a team effort. Every week starting either Thursday or Friday is an event that can last for about four to six days depending on the event.  You can get gems to purchase in game items just by completing in game quests and selling items in the marketplace. You can grow your shop. Send heroes on quests. Level up your shop and town. If I had any requests to give the devs, it would be to allow a market slot for guild mates to buy from you.

reviews.title: Perfect Game
reviews.text: It’s a very good game. It’s overall very satisfying. It’s a keeper. Some observations: the game gets very slow starting from lv 28 because crafting and quests are taking longer time. Compare to the beginning of the game there are so many things to do. It keeps the player very busy. And then it slows down. There isn’t much to do once it’s figured out the strategies. It’s just a lot of time spend waiting. Less new things are coming out, only on going upgrading and crafting. It just gets boring from this point on. (Crafting part is still very fun)   Still, it’s a game deserving the perfect rating and compliments. Thanks.

reviews.title: Good, annoyed with change from recent update
reviews.text: I really enjoy the game. However I have an issue with something that was added with the latest update. After a certain number of times a person in a guild invests in a shop, the cost of investing goes up by a large amount. My husband and I had a guild to ourselves and had invested quite a bit of gold into the shops before the update. It seems with this new system that we cannot continue investing and will be forced to open up the guild to others against our wishes, since we can't possibly afford investing anymore. I can't imagine how this new system benefits anyone, and am pretty disappointed.

reviews.title: Some paywalls...
reviews.text: I love this game don’t get me wrong, but like many others have said, you can’t even make crossbows or guns or wands or some basic enchantments without having to pay for it. This game is perfect for playing and watching a show at the same time for awhile but when you get to the higher leveled items to craft, the crafting time only gets longer and longer. While there is the way of using energy to complete the craft faster, I wish you could set the amount of energy you want to spend to lessen the time if you don’t have enough energy to complete it. I love this game and there are minor improvements to be made so I keep playing it, but in the future I’d like to see some adjustments.

reviews.title: Unplayable without $10 a month subscription
reviews.text: Don’t get me wrong, I love this time waster game. I pick it up all day long and do a little something. But, repairing your gear is impossible unless you pay $10 a month to be a “royal merchant”.  Yes they have “repair kits” but only subscribers can repair things with gold.  I paid it for over a year and built up a huge stack of repair kits. When I quit paying they ran out so fast!! It’s a vicious cycle, can’t repair gear means you can’t go on quests, can’t quest means no resources, no resources means no crafting, no crafting means no inventory for the shop - the purpose of the game. Making good gear is expensive and risky with a high breakage chance and without repair kits you’ll break things all day long with no way to replace it. To me this is the major downside of the game and $10 a month is far too expensive to just play.

reviews.title: Tons of fun - MTX is too $$$
reviews.text:
I think the devs have put together a really fun game with an addicting gameplay loot. I joined a guild recently and I really like that you can interact with guildmates easily. It isn’t all locked down like other mobile MP game’s I’ve played like this. 

The micro transactions are insanely overpriced though. The cost doesn’t even make sense. I’d imagine they’d make a lot more money by charging much less for packs. The whole point of MTX is to get your money because the cheap prices are enticing, and the buyer doesn’t realize just how much they’ve spent when they buy 20 99 cent packs. Not to tell you how to run your business or anything, but the prices desperately need rebalancing. Don’t be EA. Unless you’re owned by EA, in which case, it makes a lot of sense.... lol

reviews.title: A promising investment
reviews.text:
From its creative and plentiful events Shop Titans proves to provide a lot for both the casual and competitive player. If you are into creating the cutest little shop or completing goals on top of goals you’ll find Shop titans has a place for you to have some fun. I’m a fan of the guilds being a great place for you to be the best teammate possible to a group of like-minded people.

One gripe I have is the lack of customization on various items. You maybe able to change floors and wallpapers, but not having a plant to match the color scheme you want makes many store color options unavailable. Regardless. I enjoy using what I have to beat of my ability and I think my store is pretty nice.

reviews.title: Its a Shop Game
reviews.text: It has a bit of variety which keeps it fun, I just wish it wasn't so heavy handed in trying to get people to buy content for $15  just to unlock more crafting. Progress is pretty fast, but it'll involve a lot of farming if you are a F2Per. Ive been playing for about a month and just hit level 20 on my heroes. You can select from about 18 different classes at least, and each has 6 inventory slots that you can craft gear for, or buy from others. Not sure why there are so few reviews on this game, because it seems to be pretty popular inside the game.

reviews.title: Fun game for when you’re just sitting around.
reviews.text: It’s a really fun game and a great concept.  The only think is I wish they would add either a store hours cycle or a close shop function. Between all of the customization options of your shop and choosing what is made to sell, I want to be able to put a lot of time into doing it well and organized. But the non-stop flow of customers and the limited crafting slots makes me feel rushed. It would be nice if the shop temporarily closed so you had time to do whatever customizations or work orders you want without feeling like there are a whole bunch of customers you’re ignoring.

reviews.title: Feel like spending $100 on a game and not being able to progress?!!
reviews.text: I was absolutely addicted to this game at first. It is nice laid back fun. I paid for extras and loved it. I did learn one interesting fact...you have a 0.5% chance of obtaining one of the new items they just added on the latest update. Ridiculous! Those odds are dispiriting and the fact that I can’t obtain enough to progress  has stopped my game play with Titans completely. I am writing to let new people thinking about getting addicted, that it ends badly. I’ll take my money elsewhere. Plenty of choices out there these days that don’t charge nearly as much.

reviews.title: Addictive little game but...
reviews.text:

At first it would just consistently keep putting me back on my home screen. It would happen a few seconds into loading the game and I was convinced the game itself was just utterly broken. It had finally loaded and I thought the problem was solved and was able to play for a few days with it going back to home screen and needing to be reloaded just a few times a day. iPhone iOS 13.3.1 stable internet.

reviews.title: In Game Purchase Prices Only Drawback
reviews.text:
First, the good: this game is a lot of fun. Much to do, pleasing graphics, updates frequently. A lot of work went into this game. 

The bad: The developer asks far too much for in game unlocks; items on World of Warcraft are cheaper and that makes these prices embarrassing. One upgrade is 30$ to merely unlock a craftsman. 30$! 15$, maybe. 10$, ok much better. But a 30$ unlock is obscene. It’s a game, the item is not Real Life tangible, and most players will not jump at that price tag. Literally a total waste of money. Even Elon Musk would say, “Wow. Really?” Developers need to redesign price structure. This just comes off as pure greed, and you know there will be future unlocks just as horrifically over priced.

reviews.title: A wonderful game ruined by greed
reviews.text:
This is an amazing game.  I really enjoy playing it.  If they charged $10, $15, even $20 (a lot for a mobile game) I’d happily pay it.  But the game is free*, unless I want to craft guns and cross bows then I’ll need to buy a worker for $20+.  There are two workers for sale like that.  When your heroes equipment breaks (very very often), you can use rare items to repair them, or gold (if you have a paid subscription).  Every dungeon raid you clear prepare to find the best half of the loot unobtainable (unless of course you have the paid subscription).

I understand this game was created to make money.   Game making is a business.  This could have been a premium quality game.  But if you want to enjoy it un-neutered, be prepared to pay more than the price of a premium console game PLUS a reoccurring subscription.

reviews.title: Fun “hobby” game
reviews.text: This is a game that is very well made.  Is it p2w?  Absolutely.  Does that matter?  Only if you care enough about leaderboards.  This is a great game to bring together a handful of individuals who all have one goal, which is advancement.  The more advancement in your guild, the more slots unlock for people to join the guild.  The one caviate is that each person individually adds value to the guild.  If a big contributor all of a sudden quits the game then that may trigger a max exodus.  This phenom can split month long guilds up within a week.  Since your progress is tied directly to your guilds progress, when a big contributor leaves, that can cause some guilds to crumble.

reviews.title: The only game I’ve ever played for longer than a few days.
reviews.text: I picked up this game back in December as something to do while work is slow. Over time I started playing more and more. It’s awesome because you don’t have to constantly play it in order to get anywhere. I joined a guild at level 16 and now I’m at 43. reviews.title: Addicted

I love this game. Got a few of my friends playing it too. I’ve delt with a couple small bugs but customer support was very easy to get ahold of and got rid of the issues. My main problem with this game is how money hungry it is. I’ve spent quite a bit of money in this game and it doesn’t go very far. 
It’s a waiting game. They make their money off of those who are impatient like myself. So if you don’t like to wait it out I wouldn’t try this game unless you’re willing to spend some money. They’re very stingy on giving out diamonds once you get to higher levels so it’s almost necessary to buy them. 
 It has a lot of potential. I just hope they make it a bit easier for others who don’t spend money on games to enjoy it too.

reviews.title: Good overall game.
reviews.text: I think this is the best game that out there that fits this type of simulation. It’s even a good game to play if you don’t want to be a P2P player. To get the full experience you need to spend $9.99/mo and about $15 give  or take a few on 2 workers. There’s 1/3 events to play every 1-2 weeks so there’s always something to look forward too as well. There’s story lines to follow with workers and champions. Of course there is a market to trade on and many other things that are cool. Some things come up rarely that don’t make sense, but customer service responds very quickly and provides an answer. Hope you try it!

reviews.title: Incredibly Shady
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game consistently for a few months now.  The game is full of micro transactions, but the worst part is that after buying them, they’ll secretly tack on an extra purchase.  When I refunded one of these purchases I was “banned permanently.”  This consisted of having a 100 year ban from the market and having my gems(purchasable currency) reduced by 5000(around $50 worth).  I reached out to support for help to which they first seemed cooperative.  After giving them my account though, they responded a day later doubling down on the ban and saying quote, “ Your account can have the ban removed if you get your gems balance out of the negatives by purchasing more gems from the store until you have a gem balance of 0 or higher.”  And that’s only to be CONSIDERED for “reevaluation.”

reviews.title: It’s OK, but has glitches
reviews.text:
It can’t be addicting, but it has its flaws. Every time I made a long sword they would go straight into the inventory and not on the racks where the customers can see, and purchase them. I found myself with 15 long Swords and three racks, one completely empty and the other one stocked to the brim with mage staffs. 

Even when I tried to manually go in and select the long wards to be displayed on the racks, I couldn’t even do that, it just said “empty”, As if there was nothing else it could display. In the beginning of the game, nearly all of your customers were swordsmen. You would put your Swords on the racks, so it’s not like it’s not possible at all. Very good game, but has its bugs that it needs to fix.

reviews.title: Great game; Wish there were more player customization
reviews.text: Overall a fairly decent game and one where there’s not really anything else like it. I’d be much happier with this rather than sunglasses...

It needs to have a place where you can save your progress, or it just doesn’t take away your progress in general. Again this game is great. But I really think this problem needs to be fixed!!!

reviews.title: So cute and WORTH IT!

reviews.title: Addicting.
reviews.text:
It’s a whole nother life in a world of crafts. You get to know people. Learn from people, and progress at your pace. You find a guild, you hang there with them. My favorite thing in this game is the real time market. Where players can sell their crafts in an ever going auction-like market.

reviews.title: Addictive
reviews.text:
The game is surprisingly addictive. You can get pretty far without spending money. However, the micro transactions are way too expensive for what you get. I’d love to support the game, but 15$ for a pack is overpriced. Nothing in the shop is less than 4$, and those items hold little value unless you purchase them multiple times. If you enjoy long-term, grindy games, this is perfect for you. It has an excellent pace to keep you casually involved without sacrificing playability. It is free to play, and not pay-to-win.

However it’s so blatantly obvious how this game was made with one goal: sell overpriced game enhancements.

$10 for a monthly subscription (to an app/game that will probably keep my attention for a month) to get basic game mechanics like repairing my items? Even worse, 10% off gem pack purchases (the pay to win currency) in this game. Yikes.

reviews.title: Guild Requirements to Advance Make Game Unfun

Well, I played the game for a couple years and bought an uncomfortable amount of extras, only to have to deal with getting mysteriously kicked out of my guild when they wanted to play more hardcore and I wasn’t spending every hour of my day logging in to play. I was logging in nightly and a couple times a day, but that wasn’t enough. 

At some point, your heroes can’t level unless your guild has leveled a particular building, and to get there everyone has to play pretty hardcore… which is dumb for a mobile game. You just end up stuck if you don’t want to join some guild and get on a treadmill. 

Good while it lasted, but I won’t be returning.

reviews.title: Best shop game I’ve played in years!

Happy to say that we have been playing for months now and we still haven’t gotten tired of playing it, on top of all the other games we play on PC and consoles. We also have a guild that is super active and friendly which makes the game even more fun to play. I am not that into games like this til I played Shop Titans. Definitely worth it and it’s easy enough to play especially if you have a busy lifestyle. 🤗

reviews.title: This game is very dear to me (there’s a bug tho)
reviews.text: The emails are not sending so I can’t redeem the weekly gift. Other than that it’s playing fine. I’ve never played a game in its beta before, besides this one, and I think that is really cool. I’ve been playing since the beginning, and though I be slow, I always come back. My fiancé and I started playing it because of a close friend who knew about it first, so close that we were in his wedding. Anyway I think it would break my heart if I ever stopped being able to play this game.

reviews.title: Great fun, no stress, responsive developers
reviews.text:
I go through a lot of games, many i quit due to requiring too much time daily and the inability to take days off without falling very far behind. 

So many things to like about this game. You have the option of different strategies and there is no wrong one, play at your own pace. Spending is not required to be a competitive player. I spend because i want to, I enjoy unlocking the content and the developers are very responsive, maintain regular updates of new content rather than just recycling old content like other games. They also compensate generously for glitches. 

They earned patronage, not stole my money much unlike other games where you spend money for little to no customer support. 

Hey developers, if you read this though, we’re all jealous of the guild member with the hogwarts looking sorting hat, must have been from before I started, please bring it back!

reviews.title: Must play to rank 5
reviews.text: Sweet game, very time consuming but when you have great guild members every minute is fun, the special items are abundant and things are fast paced, although I would love to have access to more “champion” type characters for they’re more useful but in order to use them you need to get through a pay wall or put in days to weeks of playing bc they only come to your shop once every half a day or longer to give their tokens x3 and you need 50 just to get them at level 1. Overall great game, but could use a little more leniency in certain aspects of the game

reviews.title: Paywalls start early
reviews.text:
The game is fun and pretty addicting at first, but after a few days I ran into several paywalls. There are at least $50USD worth of workers early on that you cannot unlock as a free to play player. At first, I thought they’d unlock later but as I progressed (through to rank 25 shop) I did some more research and found these are never possible to achieve without jumping on the paywall. It’s really disappointing on a game with potential the devs choose not to give any option to unlock all of the core shops F2P. I don’t mind the grind, and I would have likely spent some money in the game too - but $50 on day 2 of a mobile game is way too much for some basic crafting.

Tl;dr - unless you’re willing to whale out, I’d avoid this one.

reviews.title: Having trouble. Please help. A+ btw
reviews.text:
I have played a lot over the years and love his game but however I just logged in after a long break and my account is frozen, I log into my account but cannot access anything or click on anything. City, inventory, etc.. I cannot build sell anything, m account is just plain frozen. 

I have tried every trick in the book, even the silly ones mentioned in your help guide but have had no luck. So I am reaching out trying to get one of the best cell phone games I have ever played working again

reviews.title: Great game can’t wait to see what they might add
reviews.text: Been playing for a while now and literally have 0 complaints can’t wait for new additions. If the devs are taking suggestions I would say add a story that revolves around the guild defending the city it makes sense that whatever evil all these adventurers are passing through our town may try and attack to stop their supply. So the players can equip their shop owners and their combined strength can be measured against the might of the horde invading. The players can invest in the battlements and the players hero’s can man the walls. But, if it just stays a game about money that’s fine by me too.

reviews.title: Amazing game with high prices
reviews.text:
This game is wonderful. It grabs you almost immediately. I’m game chat, guild life, farming, crafting, and story line is all that of an excellent mobile game. My ONLY problem is the cost of the “pay to win” portion of the game. Yes I agree if you want to get further ahead you have to pay something. But 30-50 USD per purchase is extremely expensive. For ALL of the purchasable characters I could get 2 or 3 console games...even the “deals” are high. I would get a one time purchase for all of the characters but this is a bit much. 

OVERALL it’s a great game though. Only 4 stars due to in game purchase prices. Otherwise it’s 5 stars all the way!

reviews.title: Fun until the cost hits you
reviews.text:
This game was extremely promising at first. It honestly has some great graphics and gameplay, but as you progress you start to see just how much it is going to cost you. I could understand paying for gems to speed things up, but the developers want you to pay $9.99 PER MONTH to access basic things. However, it doesn’t stop there. They ask you to pay $30 to unlock a character. There is no other way to access her except for paying this $30 fee. That’s insane. At least allow players to work for her, not demand them to pay an outrageous amount of cash. 

In summary, it’s a fun game until you start having to pay. After that, it just becomes an obvious cash cow that the developers are trying to milk.

reviews.title: CRAZY EXPENSIVE
reviews.text:
So I would have given this game a 4-5 star review, because it truly is a fun game that you can play to pass the time. They have cool events and guilds actually interact with it’s members to help one another. 
HOWEVER, having to spend $15-40 on simple things that other games have at $3-10 is insane. 
From new items dropping that you can get for a limited time, to the gems cost… too expensive. 
 & then they put “50%” off when it is still like $30. It’s not 50% off when you are the one deciding the value of virtual items. You just rake up the price an tell us it’s on sale. Because if it wasn’t you’re even more insane for the price

reviews.title: Constructive Criticism
reviews.text:
Overall I like this game a lot. It’s entertaining and enjoyable for me. Like most time based games though there is a big problem. The lack of game content In-Between wait times. When I buy a mobile game I want to be able to play it at a moment’s notice during anytime for any amount of time. Once you start getting into 4 tier items and the wait times begin hitting 10min, there is just a stagnant wait before you can actually do anything. 

My suggestion to alleviate this is to create a simple mini game in the game. Something you can always do regardless of time, energy, or whatever else.  Anything to benefit the player and give them something to do between wait times.

reviews.title: Great game, bad business
reviews.text: Great game. But add-on prices too steep for what some others consider to be basic mechanics. A $10 dollar subscription should come with a daily reward/currency. And for $40 Engineer should offer more than it does. I’m hoping to see some changes in the prices or what these bundles have to offer. I’ve bought the beginner, King, and champion bundle all without hesitation. But I don’t feel like I should have to pay for what the to aforementioned bundles have to offer. Maybe a one time purchase to be able to collect loot from quests; Like a “treasure troll” would be a good seller as a lot of us really hate to see the quest loot go uncollected and won’t ever subscribe monthly to a mobile game. I’ll see what updates come and change my review if any improvements come.

reviews.title: Please Read
reviews.text: Ok so I’m not a person who usually writes reviews for apps good or bad but this game has been very addicting, not only is it always keeping you busy but when it comes to upgrades for production you’re not upgrading by yourself, you have others in the small town that help you level up, it is very well balanced when it comes to making and selling and all that, the only problem I have is that every now and then it gets really slow to where I have to restart the app but that might be because of my older phone, still deserves a 5 star, it’s a great game!!

reviews.title: Get what you pay for
reviews.text: This game is beautiful! This game is lovely! This is the kind of game I’ve been waiting for! I work in a small, slow, shop in my little mountain town and love it, I play D&D with my partner and love it! I play this game at work when there isn’t a tourist for miles and love it! But boy is this game expensive, I respect that the programmers deserve all the money in the world for a game this beautiful, however I do not have the kind of money to get the most out of this game, unfortunately I have other claims to any money I make going to such classics like rent, car insurance, and power. A+++ to this beautiful company and this beautiful game, may you get all of the game of the year awards.

reviews.title: A great idea
reviews.text: I have a great idea that will make it easier for players well do u know how the game tells us to invest in a building and when we reach to the requirement it upgrades? What if u gave us the option to invest in thing we unlock at a certain level like expanding our shop to level 3 cost 1 million by the level 30 how about we invest in that even though we are at level 25 and if we reached the requirements it’s still u locked until we are at level 30 think about it its better than saving 1 millions without investing in anything so we can save up to 1 million :)

reviews.title: The game I didn’t know I needed
reviews.text: I’ve always been intrigued by ship management games, especially those with fantasy elements, dungeon exploration and a story line. None of the games I’ve tried even slightly scratched that itch until this one. Totally addictive gameplay, charming visuals, note-perfect music plus sound effects, tons to unlock...and as an ftp model it’s incredibly generous...If i wanted anything more out of this game I guess it would be enhanced dungeon exploring/resource gathering—you really fans do much with the heroes you gear up and send out to gather resources...but still overall the game is a metric ton of fun to play.

reviews.title: Real review, Love this game.
reviews.text: If you like games where you buy and sell items and run a shop, this is your game. I used to play Recettear: A shop Keeper’s Tale and have been looking for a similar game ever since. It’s not exactly the same but it’s as close as I’ve found and I love it. I’ve played for a while now and am still hooked. I like the social aspect of the guild and working as a team to achieve special awards and such. It’s not RL money based really and you can get just as far as those who do buy their way in. It’s not a super exciting game lol but it’s addictive and entertaining and I absolutely love it.

reviews.title: Market Issue
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing this game off and on for a while now. I love it and being able to design my own little DnD shop! It is a good passive game while I wait for appointments or on breaks at work and school.

Recently however, I have been unable to fully access the market. It just sits loading and loading and never allowing me to view it. The initial opening of the market I can see a small amount of items, but if i change any settings or search type, it doesn’t work. I’ve restarted the app, made sure it was up to date, and even tried playing on PC with my account. I dropped my rating down bc of it.

reviews.title: New update...
reviews.text:
Before this last update I loved this game. I played multiple times a day and my entire guild (11 people) were on every few hours. We’re in the top 3,000 for guilds and we all talked about how we never play games like these but we love Shop Titans...
CUT TO UPDATE. The update is terrible. It’s now making customers come into my shop and request items I DO NOT have in my store and CANNOT make. It totally defeats the purpose of my shop even existing since now I can just purchase and resell items in the market. It also makes it so I can’t sell what’s in my store. CHANGE IT BACK so people aren’t requesting items that I DONT HAVE IN STOCK. Horrible update. My entire guild is considering quitting because of this frustration. Loved this game before but so frustrated now.

reviews.title: Good, but costly
reviews.text:
Love the game, but once you start playing a bit you realize you can’t unlock majority of the cool item lines without dishing out some serious cash. For example, gaining access to build guns and crossbows would set you back $30, and wands? Well that’s another $20. It would cost you easily over $100 to unlock all of the special item trees, which is more than a brand new AAA game. 

I understand money has to be made, but $30 for two item trees and some gems is really outrageous. Game would be 5 stars easily if the prices weren’t so absurd. Most of these items should be base game anyways. I’d buy the packs for $5, maybe $10 a piece at most.

reviews.title: Finally a good game
reviews.text:
I typically don’t write reviews, but this game deserves one. It’s extremely fun and addicting! It’s fun to either play as an idle game or with your full attention. The most important things are that it’s not full of ads, and it’s not a cash grab. There are options to spend money, and it would make things go a little faster and you might get a few rare items but it is not necessary by any means to enjoy the game. There’s are good customization options, and it’s easy to progress.
UPDATE: Due to the recent decision to drop purchases etc for Russian players I’m dropping my subscription and deleting the game. Can’t support a game that gets political and punished people for the choices of their government. Just be a good game, don’t get involved in politics. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Most challenging and the most fun
reviews.text: Gam3lord21 here to let you know that this game is by far the best mobile MMO\RPG that I’ve ever had the opportunity to play. Granted it has its faults but it also has its upsides and it is ever evolving. The development team is very open to suggestions so don’t be afraid to use the contact us button and pass them along for consideration. Plus upon writing this review I have to inform currently a full sail university student for game design, so hopefully a steppingstone for future employment wink wink. But all joking aside a very well rounded mobile game.

reviews.title: Crashes often
reviews.text: I am unsure if this is an issue for everyone else or maybe just me so I gave 3 stars because from what I was able to play the game is cute. I downloaded the game yesterday because it looked fun and while it is adorable and seems amusing, it crashes A LOT. Every time it switches between loading screens like to go into the city or a guild it just closes. I would like to play it but I am getting irritated and not sure it is worth the hassle of constantly trying to reload it. If it is a bug then I don't mind trying again after a patch but if this is an ongoing issue-it is not worth it considering there are so many other games out there to play that don't crash.

reviews.title: Crappy take-backs!!
reviews.text: I’ve been playing this game off and on since it launched. I’ve spent more money on it than I care to admit. One of my early purchases was that I could be the “King’s Merchant” which gave great perks for the game and to me was worth it! The newest update, however, has redacted that purchase so that now it’s a weekly/monthly SUBSCRIPTION. I already spent money for it and now they’re basically just committing attempted robbery. $10 a month? Seriously? For a couple extra items and some small perks? $10 ONCE was more than enough! Maybe if there was significantly better perks than what’s offered but paying $120 a year for this game is obscene. And since they negated the money I’ve already spent, despite my fondness for the game, I likely won’t play anymore.

reviews.title: Game is glitched.
reviews.text:
Lemme start off by saying I love this game, I’m currently level 16 and have been playing the game constantly for days now. I tried to log in today and the character named Julia is prompted to show me how to use one of the spin tickets. (I’ve already spun twice for rewards before). Well the next screen where you would normally spin has you click a button to spin and the button is grayed out and I can’t click it. When I restart the app it does the same thing over and over. It won’t let me go anywhere or do anything in the game but be on that gray screen. 

I just updated the app and it still has me in that spin reward loop. Please fix this and I’ll gladly give you five stars. This game is a lot of fun, I just wanna get back to playing

reviews.title: I Absolutely Love This Game
reviews.text: I don’t have many if any complaints about this game. I love the interface, guild chat, etc. However, I find keys to be much too hard to come by. I’ve always got plenty of chests but never any keys. The main point to my review is since the update my marketplace cause the entire game to freeze I can no longer do anything but look at a darkened screen of the shop worker map. I cannot go to my shop, my guild page, nothing opens and it’s rather frustrating. Please just take note of this bug in your most recent update. No harm no foul. Love to play this game.

reviews.title: Dead Guilds
reviews.text:
The game has a great design when it comes to the graphics. I enjoy how nothing is sexualized and is very neutral. The designs for the weapons and crafting are great and it’s a good game that lets you take your time while playing it.

The only reason I did not give it full stars is because it has a huge flaw that ruins it for those wanting to remain social with other players. 

The flaw is that once you are in a guild, you can not veto out inactive guild masters like other games. You are stuck in a dead guild with other members half probably dead as well and no way to save it. You would have to leave and basically start over and lose all your active guild mates.

The game needs a hard update, one that lets you kick the dead guild master and allow someone new to take over. It’s thousands of dead guilds because of this. There is no guild rank look up option either so it’s not like you can f

reviews.title: My Kind Of Game:
reviews.text: I have been playing for at least a month now (almost constantly 😎). It is very well written. The many features unfold as you play. It is designed to make everything easily accessible. I keep thinking I will tire of it but I find it quite addicting. The only real complaint I have is that the cost of things in virtual gold go up exponentially. The guilds are nicely constructed so that as people build their city, it helps everyone else. If you are looking for a good game that does not require a lot of coordination, and doesn’t create a lot of tension, give it a try.

reviews.title: Phenominal Game to play
reviews.text:
Had to write this review, excellent game that keeps you engaged consistently, they run so many events it can be a little overwhelming but I appreciate the variety and consistent changes to keep players engaged.

I’m still “Pre 53” (level lower than 53) but from what I’ve experienced it’s been very fun, it’s not just about crafting items but also leveling hero’s and sending them on quests to get items you need.

My favorite part is there’s no PvP to stress you out and make you reach for your wallet, a lot of these games are designed to do that, ego spending is awful in some games, but this game has nothing like it. You can spend of course and it helps significantly, but you do not have to which is great.

Once again this is all “Pre 53 level” so i’m not sure what changes there yet, but it’s been a lot of fun, even if i drop it after 53 it’s still been good up til.

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: I’ve played this game for practically its whole existence (around 5 yrs).  It’s the only game I’ve ever reviewed.  I love it.  So many things to do and tasks to accomplish. You can play the game on multiple devices with ease.  No annoying ads.  Great team play if you join an active guild.  Wonderful customization and min-maxing your hero’s if you want to.  There’s always something to progress.  Regular updates that add more progression.  It never feels like a grind.  Best phone/casual game I’ve ever played.  Good job developers, keep it up!  Congrats on 5 years.

reviews.title: Amazing but can do better!
reviews.text: The game is all you can ask for in fun addicting mobile game and the best part it’s free but to an extent there’s to many options to spend real money and not enough options for the money you earn while playing the game and not enough updates for bug fixes or just updates I’m a console gamer with a decade of playing the greats of console games and it’s fun to jump on my phone and take a break form play against play to win gamers it would be great to have more options and for the community to be heard like me and others that play the game but all in all the game is great but it can be better

reviews.title: Great game, but constant crashes!
reviews.text: My only complaint about this game is it constantly crashes. It happens about 5-10 minutes apart between each crash! I’m using an sixth generation IPod and it can handle to memory of a bigger game, World of Tanks. When I transition from city to shop or make hero to shop it has a chance to crash and crashes 90% of the time when ranking up champions. I’ve seen a post on the official Shop Titans reddit page and saw that when some puts to much prestige or plants, as seen in the post, their game crashes within seconds. I wonder who else is experiencing this annoying and infuriating game crashes.

reviews.title: Broken game, useless support
reviews.text: I’ve been having this issue with my game for months. I cannot go on quests or redeem quest rewards, every time I try it kicks me from the game and I get sent to the main menu with a “lost connection to server” error message. I’ve contacted support over this numerous times and not a single person has helped. I even stopped playing the game for a bit to see if it would just fix itself magically but no. This issue is making the game hard to play as many higher level crafts need these stupid quests and buying the items from the marketplace gets expensive quickly. Because of the rudeness of the devs/support team and their lack of care for this game I definitely wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Account
reviews.text:
Phenomenal game, and I truly think it’s the best mobile game out there - BUT my chat stopped working. So I went to the settings and contacted them. Once I contacted them, about 12 hours later I get a notification to delete the game, restart my device, and  re-download it. Upon doing this, it seems as though my account has been deleted, and I am unable to recover it. There seems to be no direct way to contact them, so until this issue is resolved, my review stays at 1 star.

Edit: support was very helpful and understanding! Fixed problem shortly after.

reviews.title: Loved this game.  Then it stopped working
reviews.text: I played this game and got lost on time and would spend hours just upgrading and crafting and selling. It was a great fun little game.  Then it started crashing.   I disabled all visuals and alerts and lowered it to the lowest settings and it would still freeze.  The last straw was when I loaded it this morning and it would freeze before I could click anything.  I tried reloading it 9 more times.  And the same result every time.   It’s such a shame that it will not play properly, I’d happily give it five stars if it just loaded and played.  I’m glad I didn’t invest any real money into it.  I’m playing on iOS.  I cleared my cache and closed all other applications and the game was opened with nothing else running.  This did not fix the problem.

reviews.title: Love it.
reviews.text: I don’t normally leave reviews, but I am in love with this game. The mechanics are solid, the progression is easy and fun, the guild system actually works well and I have joined friends, love making investments to help everyone. I personally was expecting another terrible, pay-to-win, idle game. I could not recommend it enough. There is so much unique content and fun items, upgrading your heroes, and unlocking new blueprints is amazing. The paid aspect is just more, not required, and it helps to support these great devs. Looking forward to seeing how great this game gets as it is updated. Go play it now!

reviews.title: Better than Shop Heroes
reviews.text: I first played Shop Heroes, and then played their new release, Shop Heroes Legends. This game is much more polished and well put together than their counterpart, who suffers from clunkyness and issues that make the game difficult to want to play at times. I wish I would have found this game sooner. To anyone interested in giving this a try, please do. You can play this to its fullest without spending a dollar, but it does speed things up if you value your time more than money.

reviews.title: Fun but ruined by greed
reviews.text:
The most blatantly monetized game I’ve played in a long time.
Don’t plan to get much further than tier 3 gear unless you drop some serious dough to unlock shop space, workers and quest/character slots.
You’ll also find it also difficult to get the materials you need from questing because your heroes take extremely long to recover.
When your gear breaks (which it does inevitably) you’ll have to buy more unless you are a monthly subscriber ($10/mo) to unlock gold use for gear repairs. Of course if you want to spend gems on quest recovering, repairing gear that you broke (which is the games real currency), you’ll have to buy via IAP for exorbitant amounts.
I guess people tolerate this nowadays, I simply can’t stomach it. This would easily be a $5-10 game if it wasn’t so grabby and pay to play.
There’s also no offline progression, expect to have to check your phone every 1-3 minutes to keep

reviews.title: 4.7 Star NOT!
reviews.text:
Game is a joke and star ratings are a lie. If you don’t pay, your not making it anywhere in the game. After a month I’ve come to a complete stand still. Can’t upgrade shop. NPCs buy nothing over a lvl 3. So your not making money. Have no choice but to wait for outrageously long wait times. Can’t upgrade anything in the city it’s too expensive. Rarely get keys from quests and if you do they are locked unless you pay. Just spent 20 fortune spins to make under 300 star coins. Can’t ascend because there is no real way to get ascension tickets. All around the game is a joke claiming to be free play when it’s really a pay to play. 

Also, they don’t care how much damage their app does to your device. They know that the app causes over heating. And they don’t care enough to fix it.

reviews.title: New things to be added
reviews.text: The game is very addictive and I can’t get enough. To make the game even better there should be a way to close the shop to restock the store. It’s are to keep up with inventory when customers are always coming in. Also in the guild there should be a way to fight other guilds with your hero’s. You should battle your hero’s in your own guild then that champion should go on to fight the champion of another guild. Since you have to make the equipment for them you should be able to do that with them. Other than these few things the game is very well created and has lots more to come.

reviews.title: Good game, bad developers
reviews.text:
The game concept is actually really solid for a casual game and something that can be played when you have time without too much stress over the game.

The problem is the tech support (I’m looking at you Tristan) is not player friendly. They are very antagonistic and can be quite rude. Add in the fact that the in game percentages are wrong (over two years of running spreadsheets on this game) and that the odds change depending on if you buy the subscription or not. It really feels like I got ripped off. If you going in understanding and accepting it won’t work as displayed, you will probably enjoy the game.
Cheers

reviews.title: Unique
reviews.text:
I’m really big on high fantasy worlds, but so rarely are they well executed; they’re usually disrespectful to women, disabled people, or some minority somewhere. However, this game has all of the fun, none of the pitfalls! It’s delightful (and addictive!) in a way that most mobile games usually aren’t for me.
I saw an ad for it, and clicked on it because it was the first ad for a mobile game that I’d seen in a while... at least, the first ad that wasn’t clear clickbait for a game that took half an hour to make. I downloaded it, and I’m having a blast! 5 stars!

reviews.title: Addicting and fun
reviews.text: I love this game. It’s addicting and fun to play. There’s always plenty to do, no long wait times like other games. You can play as long as you like or as little as you like. Also no ads! Which is a definite plus for me. The only downside is that it crashes somewhat frequently, and has issues with disconnecting from the game server, and then refuses to reload without you force quitting the game and then logging back in. Happens like 4-5 times a day which can be frustrating.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: The game has a lot of fun aspects but you really need to have a big guild to get anywhere. My wife and I created a guild and only have a couple members. With the new update we really can't keep ahead of the building degradation so we can't get much farther. The click system will be fine for you if you get into a big guild. As it stands they pretty much made small guilds obsolete. We will likely stop paying the monthly subscription, which also is pretty important if you ever want to open chests or get viable quest rewards. Overall, ok game wouldn't get too invested at this time unless you find a big guild with some open slots and are ok with putting some cash into it regularly.

reviews.title: Fun now but worried for the future
reviews.text: While this game is a great because u can be fairly creative and team up with other merchants to make towns I am scared about the future of the game. As I write this, two workers have been added to the game (workers give u recipes and recipe trees to make that you can sell in your store) that can only be accessed for $20. Not only is it annoying and frustrating that they cost money but the price tag of $20 is simply outrageous. I’m starting to notice through the updates that the more they update it, the harder it becomes to keep at pace with pay to win players and it is becoming harder to just enjoy the game without the constant nagging to buy bundles.

reviews.title: Add more content please
reviews.text: I’ve never written a review and I promise you this game is amazing but a few things could be improved visually and game content. Like adding it to where your shops surroundings match the city map. Wall hangings. A guild shop and guild items to sell in the shop specifically. Also you could add in some more item types you can craft. This game is wonderful as is but if you added anything like I’ve suggested it would be amazing... great job and the only downside to the game is it could be looked at as pay to win but it definitely isn’t

reviews.title: Buggy as Hades
reviews.text:
Why a game company would put out what is obviously an alpha release is beyond me. I have to restart the game every 10-15 minutes because it hangs. So many bugs!

* Reforging breaks half the time. You have to turn buyer away because the mob never sees a newly forged item
* City grays out randomly when examining your builders
* general hangs at random moments
* screen will sometimes gray out during selections
* visits to see new furnishings never resets new items, you have to try to place the item to reset the new item alert

Needed features should be in game

* make it easier to send quests out for low materials, not just empty materials (e.g., sort dungeons by materials owned) (incr, decr)
* make it more apparent when you’re selling something you can’t build but purchased earli

reviews.title: Money burning game
reviews.text:
This game is unplayable unless you spend (a lot of) money. 

My wife and I have spent over $350 on this game (we bought the premium workers and half a year of the "Royal Merchant"). 

For that kind of money, we expected to be able to gleefully play along with no speedbumps. 

We had to stop the "Royal Merchant" subscription, and within a few months we each went from having a surplus of "Repair Kits" (600 of them each) to less than 50. Without Repair Kits, our heroes' gear will break permanently, requiring a replacement. Replacements can be bought for in-game currency or made with materials from dungeons we can only send heroes to if they _have_ gear. 

We'll likely have to stop playing the game, as it's not reasonable for us to resume the subscription right now. Shame on the devs for designing the game this way. For $350 we should be able to play without worrying about this.

reviews.text:
Normally I cycle through games on my phone every couple months, but I picked up this game during the pandemic and have kept playing it ever since! 

If you like shop builders and questing for materials to build unique blueprints, you’ll love this game.

Join a guild and work as a team during events!

The art is cute and well done and the devs have worked to keep up with advancing players by releasing new content at regular intervals.

I just recently had an issue getting disconnected from my account and the Kabam crew helped link me back to my main after a mishap with my phone.

10/10, fun to play, keeps me engaged daily, and most importantly, no ads!! Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: Fun Base Game, but the company DOES NOT CARE about the customer
reviews.text:
Short version: if the company cared about the customer, they would give their in-game customer support the tools they need to help customers. However, after dealing with Support, it’s clear they are unable to do anything other than provide apologies.

I was ready to write this game a four-star, but after dealing with Support, I’ve made it one. If a game won’t respect your time, why are you going to give it your time? To anyone who reads this, you’re better off finding a game that puts the customer first. This is not one.

reviews.title: My favorite game! Edit: Was my favorite game 1/25/24
reviews.text: I dearly love this game. First off, I love that the creators respect their players enough to not overwhelm us with those annoying ads you have to watch in order to play. You have expansion packs and stuff packs essentially that enhance your game experience, but those are optional and not forced p2p. I’m more likely to purchase this way anyway. Second, the quality of the game is amazing. The creators are constantly enhancing the game play without loosing the purpose of the game. A lot of games can morph into something totally different and loose the original game that people loved in the process. The core game that people fell in love with is the same. Just enhanced. And finally, this game is downright fun. There is always something to do even when you’re waiting while crafting and questing. Adore this game. Edit 01/25/2024 I still love this game and have been playing for a very long time
